Account settings now finish loading when signed out. Signing in again keeps the saved gateway for the same account, removes it when switching accounts, and revokes the previous Cloud session. Canceling Apple sign-in shows a retry message.

Chat history keeps its pagination cursor through session updates and lets failed requests for earlier messages be retried.

Includes the Cloud session and pairing security updates. Bundles gateway 0.16.31; protocol 92 and gateway config version 28 are unchanged. Build 15.
